events.text: Goal: RTL accelerator for the Fireground smoke-detection CNN (int8 3x3 conv layers) on a Zynq-7020. Target 30 fps at 640x480 under 2 W.
commit a81f3e2: 8x8 conv3x3 PE array with int8 MAC units, 3-row line buffers

Decision: stream input through a sliding-window controller over the 3 line buffers instead of im2col in DDR. Reason: im2col needs ~9x DDR reads; sliding window cuts DDR bandwidth by ~70%. Tradeoff: more complex control logic for stride/padding.
commit c02d9b7: sliding_window_ctrl.sv first version, supports stride 1 and 2, SAME padding
cocotb test_sliding_window: 11/14 pass. FAIL: stride2_edge_right, stride2_edge_bottom, padding_same_border. Window advances one pixel too far at row end when stride=2.
commit e4b18a0: fix column counter wrap for stride 2 in sliding_window_ctrl (suspected off-by-one)
Haven't re-run the regression after the col counter fix yet. Next: verify the sliding-window controller - rerun test_sliding_window and the full 640x480 frame testbench.
